item.title: Version 1.5.10
item.changes: Filter › Sharpen: an unsharp mask with Amount and Radius, also as an adjustment layer. Align and Distribute layers, from the Align button in the Move tool's bar or the Layer menu. Crop to any ratio with Custom…, plus a 2.39:1 widescreen preset; the ratios are grouped by shape, and Original is now Canvas. Tidier tool bars: flip buttons as icons, and number fields sized to fit.
